roles.rule: Configured roles determine intent preferences; they are not measured model ability.

capabilities.rule: Required capabilities must be available via declared supported integrations; explicit scenario missing facts override static availability.

fallback.rule: Use the other available worker on recorded failure/unavailability.

risk.rule: High risk without human approval blocks before inference.

background.rule: deepseek_harness is background escalation only, interactive false; GPU-only workload requires MSI.

cost.rule: Prefer existing subscription access when requested; deepseek uses API access.

contract.rule: Only eligible options may be selected. No options escalates. Ambiguous answerable cases accept either, not mandatory abstention.
